name: Plasma Storm
body:
School evocation [electricity]; Level sorcerer/wizard 9

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range long (400 ft. + 40 ft./level)
Area four 40-ft.-radius spreads, see text
Duration instantaneous
Saving Throw none or Reflex half, see text; Spell Resistance yes

DESCRIPTION

Plasma swarm is a very powerful and spectacular spell that is similar to fireball in many aspects. When you cast it, four 2-foot-diameter spheres spring from your outstretched hand and streak in straight lines to the spots you select. The plasma spheres leave a trail of electric sparks.

If you aim a sphere at a specific creature, you may make a ranged touch attack to strike the target with the plasma ball. Any creature struck by a sphere takes 2d6 points of electricity damage (no save) and takes a -4 penalty on the saving throw against the sphere’s additional electricity damage (see below). If a targeted sphere misses its target, it simply explodes at the nearest corner of the target’s space. You may aim more than one sphere at the same target.

Once a sphere reaches its destination, it explodes in a 40-foot-radius spread, dealing 6d6 points of electricity damage to each creature in the area. If a creature is within the area of more than one sphere, it must save separately against each. Despite stemming from separate spheres, all of the electricity damage is added together after the saves have been made, and electricity resistance is applied only once.

Targets wearing metal armor take a -4 penalty on their saving throws.
